name: Congenital Neutropenia with ELANE Mutation
aliases: Severe Congenital Neutropenia (SCN) due to ELANE mutation

criteria.description: Persistent severe neutropenia with absolute neutrophil count (ANC) < 500/µL
Identification of pathogenic mutation in the ELANE gene
History of recurrent bacterial infections starting in infancy or early childhood
Bone marrow examination showing maturation arrest of myeloid lineage at promyelocyte/myelocyte stage

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Persistent severe neutropenia (ANC < 500/µL) plus pathogenic ELANE mutation and recurrent infections
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other causes of neutropenia and may include bone marrow biopsy for confirmation.

pathognomonic.notes: Predominantly affecting skin, respiratory tract, and oral mucosa

common.notes: Painful ulcers often present due to neutropenia
Common sites include face and extremities

occasional.notes: Middle ear infections secondary to neutropenia

rare.symptomName: Progression to myelodysplastic syndrome or acute myeloid leukemia
rare.notes: Occurs in a minority of patients over time
May occur secondary to chronic infection or hematologic complications

laboratory: Bone marrow showing myeloid maturation arrest
imaging: Chest X-ray may show pneumonia during infections
genetic: Pathogenic mutation in ELANE gene confirmed by molecular genetic testing
other: Clinical history of recurrent bacterial infections starting in infancy

distinguishingFeatures: Periodic oscillations in neutrophil counts with ~21-day cycles
Less severe infections compared to congenital neutropenia
Neutropenia with additional hematologic and systemic features

redFlags: Severe recurrent bacterial infections in infancy
Signs of progression to leukemia or myelodysplastic syndrome
references: Dale DC, et al. Severe congenital neutropenia. Hematology Am Soc Hematol Educ Program. 2004.
Horwitz MS, et al. ELANE mutations in severe congenital neutropenia. Blood. 2007.
Newburger PE, Dale DC. Evaluation and management of patients with isolated neutropenia. Semin Hematol. 2013.
